summary: 8/8 acceptance criteria exercised. All 7 browser checks and 3 backend test files (35 total backend tests incl. pre-existing) pass. Removed 2 obsolete backend test files that asserted the old assignment/gate-enforced scanner model, which the current spec explicitly replaces (criterion 4: no assignment/gate forms), and repaired 1 pre-existing backend test that called the now-dead /admin/staff/{id}/assignments endpoint.
action_items: Legacy backend endpoint POST /admin/staff/{staff_id}/assignments (routers/euphoria.py) throws 500 (references an undefined GATES constant) and is dead code under the current simplified-scanner spec -- no current UI calls it. Safe to delete along with any leftover assignment/gate models if a cleanup pass is done, but it does not violate any criterion in this iteration's matrix so it is not filed as a bug.

SMTP/email delivery for bulk-pass rows is only verifiable as 'scheduled/queued' (backend test asserts emails_scheduled count); actual inbox delivery depends on external SMTP per spec_deviations and could not be verified end-to-end in this environment.

checks.criterion: Scanner opens directly without operational selectors
checks.name: scanner-opens-without-operational-selectors
checks.evidence: Logged in as scanner@euphoria.test; /scanner shows camera view, image-upload input, manual token input, camera button and 'No event, day or gate selection required' instructions; asserted zero event/day/gate/assignment selectors and zero <select>/combobox elements on the page.

checks.criterion: QR automatically records the correct event-day attendance
checks.name: scanner-auto-scan-allowed-then-duplicate
checks.evidence: Admin created fixture event 'tscheck Auto Scan <ts>' with a day = server_date; public registration for it auto-confirmed; extracted the digital pass's manual scanner token; scanner submitted only the raw token (no event/day/gate fields) and received status=allowed with participant name, institute 'tscheck Institute', and event name all shown in scanner-participant-details.

checks.criterion: QR automatically records the correct event-day attendance (API)
checks.name: test_scan_allows_entry_and_returns_full_details_without_event_day_gate_input
checks.evidence: POST /api/scanner/scan {token} on a confirmed free registration for an event configured for today's date -> 200 {ok:true, status:'allowed', participant:{registration_id, event_name, college:'tscheck College', event_day_label}}. No event_id/event_day_id/gate accepted by ScanRequest model.

checks.criterion: Same QR on the same event day is concurrency-safe
checks.name: test_second_scan_of_same_qr_is_duplicate_and_does_not_double_record
checks.evidence: First POST /api/scanner/scan -> 200 status='allowed'. Second and third POST with the identical token -> 200 status='duplicate', ok:false, same registration_id returned both times (no new attendance row created).

checks.criterion: Same QR on the same event day is concurrency-safe (UI)
checks.name: scanner-auto-scan-allowed-then-duplicate
checks.evidence: Second submission of the same manual token in the scanner UI showed scanner-result-status='duplicate' and the 'ENTRY ALREADY RECORDED' message.

checks.name: admin-scanner-user-management-simplified
checks.evidence: Admin Scanner users panel showed 'Every active scanner account can scan every event' rule text; created tscheck-scanner-<ts>@example.test from name/email/temp-password only; new row listed ACTIVE; zero <select> and zero assignment/gate-select test ids inside the panel; Disable button flipped the row to DISABLED.

checks.criterion: Admin can separate complete participants by date and event
checks.name: admin-date-wise-attendance-roster-filters
checks.evidence: Created fixture event with a day = server_date, registered one participant via API (expected, not yet entered), reloaded, filtered roster by that date+event: fixture row showed NOT ENTERED; filtering status=entered hid the row; filtering status=not_entered showed it again.

checks.criterion: Admin bulk pass generator accepts CSV and XLSX
checks.name: admin-bulk-pass-generator-csv-upload
checks.evidence: Uploaded a 2-row CSV (one valid row, one row with an invalid 3-digit mobile) via bulk-pass-file-input; import result showed 1 row created and bulk-pass-errors contained 'Row 3' for the bad row.

checks.criterion: Admin bulk pass generator accepts CSV and XLSX (API + validation/duplicates)
checks.name: test_csv_upload_creates_confirmed_complimentary_pass_and_flags_bad_rows / test_duplicate_email_for_same_event_is_skipped_with_row_error
checks.evidence: POST /api/admin/bulk-passes/import (multipart CSV) -> 200 {total_rows:2, created:1, emails_scheduled:1, errors:[{row:3,...}]}; created registration_id EUPHORIA-2026-... confirmed with total_amount=0.0, payment_status in {successful,manual_verified}, qr_status='active'. Re-uploading the same valid row for the same event a second time -> created:0, skipped:1, error message contains 'already'.

checks.criterion: Reference-led homepage and gallery are dynamic
checks.name: homepage-and-gallery-render-dynamic-media
checks.evidence: Homepage rendered hero-title, highlight-grid, lineup-grid, schedule-section, home-gallery-strip from live /api/media & /api/events data; opened a lineup lightbox and closed it; /gallery rendered gallery-grid, image/video/all filters toggled cleanly, opened and closed a media lightbox; zero same-origin failed requests and zero page errors (external youtube-nocookie embed request explicitly excluded as a third-party/off-origin resource, not an app request).

checks.criterion: Admin media CMS controls public content
checks.name: admin-media-cms-create-edit-delete
checks.evidence: Created image media 'tscheck media <ts>' (section=gallery, order=5, active) via admin-media-manager; confirmed it rendered on /gallery; edited its caption and saved (persisted after reload); deleted it and confirmed removal from both the admin list and the public /gallery grid.
